culture.text: A large US manufacturer with about 19,000 employees in 27 countries and more than 60 brands, from boat engines to marine electronics and boat clubs.
Staff mostly studied at US schools such as Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Wisconsin-Oshkosh and DePaul, in business, finance, marketing, computer science and mechanical engineering.
Main jobs are in operations, engineering, IT, sales and business development.

growth.text: Is betting on AI self-docking boats and a defence deal with Textron to drive growth.
Listed on the New York Stock Exchange, with roots going back to 1845.

worth_knowing.text: CEO David Foulkes is retiring and Aine Denari has been named the new CEO.
Further management changes, including two new division presidents and a new technology chief, take effect on 1 January 2027.
Was named a Forbes World's Best Employer in 2022, for the third year running.
